instruction: You are given a dynamic-mesh template `/home/user/Desktop/dynamic_base/`. Complete rigid-body-motion dynamic-mesh analysis from the command line: 1. Modify and create `/home/user/Desktop/dynamic/`: - Build flow-field geometry with an internal body - Configure rigid-body motion law (oscillation or rotation) - Set dynamic-mesh solver and boundary conditions - Run to the specified time 2. Extract body-surface forces. 3. Write a post-processing script to output `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt`: - Final-time surface drag `final_fx` - Format: `final_fx` 4. Do not use GUI tools. [Software] OpenFOAM is normally used from a shell after sourcing your installation environment (e.g. its `etc/bashrc`); `foamRun -help` verifies solver binaries are available.
